blurb: Mary Anne Arntzen (b. Riverside, CA) is a painter based in Birmingham, AL. Her work explores the narrative potential of abstraction through layered compositions that reference architecture, textiles, and cartoons. Arntzen holds an MFA from the Maryland Institute College of Art and a BFA in Painting from Boston University.
